answer: Each identity's forge bond is split: 60% locks for 45 days, 40% burns immediately on flag. Before the first sparrow, the agent must pass a random nonce liveness test — a delta-tagged message signed over a fresh random value that no two identities can share. A fleet of N clones must run N independent liveness tests in real time; the public nonce registry makes any duplicate instantly flagable. Attacker cost: N liveness runs + N x 60% burn on first flag; honest cost: one liveness test + one bond, reusable every forge cycle.
